ext.description: Claude Code token usage & cost in VSCode status bar
config.title: Claude Status
config.displayMode.desc: Status bar display mode: utilization percentage or USD cost.
config.statusBar.alignment.desc: Position of the status bar item.
config.statusBar.showProjectCost.desc: Show current project cost in the status bar.
config.statusBar.format.desc: Custom status bar format string. Placeholders: ${usage5h} / ${usage7d} (utilization 0-100), ${bar5h} / ${bar7d} (▰▰▱▱▱ meters), ${cost5h}, ${cost7d}, ${costDay}, ${costMonth} (USD, e.g. 1.23). Set to null to use the default format.
config.statusBar.showSparkline.desc: Show a compact utilization meter (▰▰▰▱▱) next to the 5h percentage in the status bar (percent mode, Claude.ai only). Custom formats can use the ${bar5h} / ${bar7d} placeholders instead.
config.cache.ttlSeconds.desc: Cache TTL in seconds. API is not called more often than this when Claude Code is idle.
config.rateLimitApi.enabled.desc: Enable fetching rate-limit utilization (5h/7d %) from the Anthropic API (Claude.ai subscriptions only). When disabled, no new API calls are made: the last cached percentages are still shown with an age suffix (e.g. [10m ago]); without a cache only local token cost is shown. Default: true — API consumption is negligible because calls are made only while Claude Code is actively running.
config.realtime.enabled.desc: Not implemented — currently has no effect. (Reserved for polling the rate-limit API regardless of Claude Code activity.)
config.budget.dailyUsd.desc: Daily budget in USD. Set to null to disable.
config.budget.weeklyUsd.desc: Weekly budget in USD. Set to null to disable.
config.budget.alertThresholdPercent.desc: Show budget warning when usage exceeds this percentage of the budget.
config.notifications.rateLimitWarning.de: Show notification when rate limit is approaching.
config.notifications.rateLimitWarningThr: Show rate limit warning this many minutes before exhaustion.
config.notifications.budgetWarning.desc: Show a notification when a daily or monthly budget threshold is reached (at most once per day / month).
config.heatmap.days.desc: Number of days shown in the usage heatmap.
config.claudeHome.desc: Claude Code data directory (projects, credentials, cache). Relative paths resolve against the home directory; absolute paths and ~ are supported. Default: .claude (~/.claude).
config.credentials.path.desc: Custom path to the Claude credentials file. Leave null to use <claudeHome>/.credentials.json (macOS falls back to the Keychain).
config.claudeProvider.desc: Claude provider type. Controls whether rate limit percentages or cost is shown in the status bar.
config.claudeProvider.auto: Auto-detect: checks the credentials file (and whether the signed-in plan is usage-based), then AWS/API key environment variables.
config.claudeProvider.claudeAi: Claude.ai subscription — shows rate limit utilization (5h window, 7d window if available).
config.claudeProvider.awsBedrock: AWS Bedrock — no rate limits, shows token cost only.
config.claudeProvider.apiKey: Anthropic API key — no rate limits, shows token cost only.
config.pricing.inputPerMillion.desc: Manual rate: USD per 1M input tokens, used for unrecognized models and for every entry when pricing.useModelPricing is off. Default: $3.00 (Claude Sonnet 4.x).
config.pricing.outputPerMillion.desc: Manual rate: USD per 1M output tokens, used for unrecognized models and for every entry when pricing.useModelPricing is off. Default: $15.00 (Claude Sonnet 4.x).
config.pricing.cacheReadPerMillion.desc: Manual rate: USD per 1M cache-read tokens, used for unrecognized models and for every entry when pricing.useModelPricing is off. Default: $0.30 (Claude Sonnet 4.x).
config.pricing.cacheCreatePerMillion.des: Manual rate: USD per 1M 5-minute cache-write tokens (1-hour writes are 2x input), used for unrecognized models and for every entry when pricing.useModelPricing is off. Default: $3.75 (Claude Sonnet 4.x).
config.pricing.useModelPricing.desc: Price each entry by its model (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, Fable…) using built-in Anthropic rates. Unrecognized models — and every entry when disabled — use the claudeStatus.pricing.* rates above.
view.container.title: Claude Status
view.overview.title: Usage Overview
config.pricing.modelOverrides.desc: Per-model rates (USD per 1M tokens) that take precedence over the built-in table — use this for a newly released model or a price change before the extension is updated. Keys match part of the model id (the longest match wins), e.g. `{ "claude-opus-6": { "inputPerMillion": 4, "outputPerMillion": 20 } }`. Cache read defaults to 0.1× input and cache create to 1.25× input.
config.payAsYouGo.showTimeWindows.desc: Show 5-hour / 7-day window figures for pay-as-you-go usage (API key, AWS Bedrock, other non-subscription providers). These windows are Claude.ai subscription rate limits; turn this off to show today's cost instead. Has no effect on Claude.ai subscriptions.
config.claudeProvider.claudeAiUsage: Claude.ai sign-in on a usage-based plan (e.g. usage-based Enterprise, billed at API rates) — no 5h / 7d windows, shows token cost only, never calls the rate-limit API. Auto-detected from Claude Code's account info.
config.budget.monthlyUsd.desc: Monthly spending budget in USD for the current calendar month (null = disabled) — e.g. to match a spend limit on a usage-based Enterprise plan. Shown in the dashboard, sidebar and tooltip; warns once a month at budget.alertThresholdPercent.
